messages:
Maya: Heads up — HelixLabs reported another 503 spike during their midday traffic window. Got alerted at ~2026-03-15 16:12 PST. Seems similar to last week's repeat incidents.

Dina: Noted. Is this on Dedicated or Hosted? Any customer impact details?

Maya: Dedicated pool (ded-helix-01). They saw ~3.2% error rate for ~12 mins; latency up to 900ms. Usage + cost spike due to retries. Customer is asking for root cause and timeline.

Carlos (Eng-Runtime): I'll grab the logs. Can you paste request IDs or a sample trace?

Maya: Sample trace attached (copied below):
```
error: http 503 service_unavailable
kv_cache: miss
runtime: OOM? fragment->alloc fail
trace_id: hl-20260315-5421
```

Ben (SRE): Looks like the pool ran out of ephemeral memory; we've seen fragmentation when KV cache grows during long sessions. Will check alloc metrics.

Ryan (Eng-SRE): I'm going to restart a worker in the pool to flush caches and monitor. ETA 10m. I'll post metrics after.

OpsBot: Scheduled restart on ded-helix-01 at 2026-03-15T23:35:00Z by @Ryan. Incident ticket #INC-2549 created.

Ryan (Eng-SRE): Restart done. Error rate dropped to 0.4% in the first 15m. Reaching out to ops for a longer retention capture.

Carlos (Eng-Runtime): Action items: (1) Add auto-reclaim hook for expired KV segments; (2) add OOM guard to fallback to smaller cache; (3) ship a patch to canary cluster by EOD.

Dina (CS Ops): I'll coordinate a canary with HelixLabs for Friday during a low-traffic window. Also propose a credit for their retry cost. Maya — ok to offer 10% account credit?

Maya: Yep, approved. I'll draft the note and share for review.

Carlos (Eng-Runtime): Patch pushed to canary (canary-ded-02). Monitoring for 24h. If stable, we'll schedule rollout Mon-Tue next week.

Ryan (Eng-SRE): Can we add a dashboard card for KV fragmentation and set alert >70%?

Ben (SRE): Yep — I'll create the alert and add runbook link.

Maya: Summary of ownership and next steps:
- Maya (CSM): Communicate credit + customer note, schedule Friday canary test
- Dina (CS Ops): Coordinate windows, prepare playbook
- Carlos (Eng-Runtime): Patch, monitor canary, plan rollout
- Ryan (Eng-SRE): Restarted pool, create alert, assist with rollout
- Ben (SRE): Runbook + alert wiring

Next check-in: Friday 09:30 PT or sooner if canary shows regressions. Please update INC-2549 with any findings.

Maya: tagging @HelixLabs-PM in the customer note draft once ready. :pray:

Ryan (Eng-SRE): Thanks all. Good catch on the pattern.
